blocks.x: What holds Decision Intelligence Systems together is discipline at the boundaries — typed contracts between stages, versioned releases, and a replay trail for every decision. The diagram above shows how the pieces compose; the gate reviews are what keep them honest.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Decision Intelligence Systems capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.
